exercises.name: Warm-Up: Assault Bike or Jump Rope
exercises.notes: Easy pace, build light sweat and nasal breathing.

exercises.name: Warm-Up: Dynamic Mobility Circuit
exercises.notes: World’s greatest stretch, ankle rocks, hip openers, T-spine rotations.

exercises.name: 1. Countermovement Jump
exercises.notes: Max intent each rep, stick soft landing, rest 45–60 sec.

exercises.name: 2. Medicine Ball Chest Pass
exercises.notes: Explode straight from chest, full intent, reset between reps.

exercises.name: 3. Goblet Squat
exercises.notes: RPE 7, controlled down, full depth you can own, drive up hard.

exercises.name: 4. Dumbbell Bench Press
exercises.notes: RPE 7, neutral or slight pronated grip, 2 sec lower, strong press.

exercises.name: 5. Chest-Supported Row
exercises.notes: RPE 7, pull elbows back, pause briefly at top, no shrugging.

exercises.name: 6. Romanian Deadlift
exercises.notes: RPE 7, soft knees, hinge at hips, feel hamstrings, keep spine neutral.

exercises.name: 7. Walking Lunge
exercises.notes: Smooth steps, upright torso, control knee tracking.

exercises.name: 8. Ab Wheel Rollout
exercises.notes: Brace hard, ribs down, only go as far as you can keep control.

exercises.name: 9. Neck Flexion + Extension
exercises.notes: Use light plate or harness if available, slow and controlled.

exercises.name: 10. Farmer Carry
exercises.notes: Heavy but stable, tall posture, crush grips, steady breathing.

exercises.name: 11. Aerobic Finisher: Assault Bike
exercises.notes: Zone 2 pace, conversational effort, smooth breathing.

exercises.name: 8. Weighted Sit-Up
exercises.notes: Hold plate at chest, controlled down, strong exhale up.

exercises.name: 10. Farmer Carry

exercises.name: Warm-Up: Assault Bike or Jump Rope
exercises.notes: Easy pace, build light sweat and nasal breathing.

exercises.name: Warm-Up: Dynamic Mobility Circuit
exercises.notes: World’s greatest stretch, ankle rocks, hip openers, T-spine rotations.

exercises.name: 1. Broad Jump
exercises.notes: Jump far with full intent, land balanced, reset each rep.

exercises.name: 2. Medicine Ball Rotational Scoop Throw
exercises.notes: Rotate through hips and trunk, fast hands, full reset each rep.

exercises.name: 3. Front Squat
exercises.notes: RPE 7–8, choose a load you can keep clean posture with.

exercises.name: 4. Incline Dumbbell Bench Press
exercises.notes: RPE 7–8, controlled lowering, aggressive press.

exercises.name: 5. One-Arm Dumbbell Row
exercises.notes: RPE 8, pull elbow toward hip, avoid torso twisting.

exercises.name: 6. Romanian Deadlift
exercises.notes: RPE 7–8, hinge cleanly and keep lats tight.

exercises.name: 7. Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.notes: Use dumbbells if stable, control depth, drive through front foot.

exercises.name: 8. Hanging Leg Raise
exercises.notes: Strict reps, avoid swinging, pelvis tucks at top.

exercises.name: 9. Neck Flexion + Extension
exercises.notes: Moderate load, smooth controlled reps.

exercises.name: 10. Farmer Carry
exercises.notes: Heavy carry, tall posture, crush the handles.

exercises.name: 11. Tempo Conditioning: Assault Bike Intervals
exercises.notes: Work at RPE 7, keep output repeatable and smooth.

exercises.name: 8. Weighted Sit-Up
